Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper senpai,

name: story_note_02_body
Xiaoman:
The little tavern is finally open! ٩(ˊᗜˋ*)و

Before opening, I peeled the last bit of protective film off the glass door. The blue sign across the street reflects in it. It turned out rather pretty.

Then the first person to walk past asked, ‘Are you still renovating?’

…I'd forgotten to take down the ‘Under renovation’ sign. I checked the menu over and over, and somehow missed the most obvious thing. Honestly…

This is the tape I played when I opened. I'd like you to hear it too. (´,,•ω•,,)♡

name: story_note_03_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper senpai,

name: story_note_03_body
Xiaoman:
After asking you to help yesterday, I realized you have your own shop to run during the day.

Would working here in the evenings leave you too tired?

But when the dock shifts change, so many customers arrive at once. Sometimes I really can't manage them all on my own.

Please don't feel you have to. You're always welcome to just come for a drink, and if you do help, I'll make sure you're properly paid!

Here's this week's tape.

Xiaoman: Good evening, senpai. There is something I would like to discuss today.

name: xm_04_02

name: xm_04_shop
Xiaoman: I would like some drinking water today. I have {0} credits.

name: xm_04_cocktail
Xiaoman: I also brought two bottled juice drinks from the bar. Would you like a look?

name: story_note_04_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_04_body
Xiaoman:
After mentioning supplies yesterday, I went back and made another list of what the bar needs.

I used to write down only what was missing that day. Now I am planning ingredients for the weeks ahead.

It is tiring, but I am happy.

There is still so much you can teach me about running a shop.

Please do not feel you have to agree right away. You have your own business. We can talk when it suits you.

Here is this week's tape. (´,,•ω•,,)♡

I have enclosed this week's supply categories. Come and see me if you are interested.

name: story_note_05_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_05_body
Xiaoman:
The new drinks are finally on the menu!

The ingredients are rare stock from the new supplier.

I tried several times, but something was always missing. Yesterday I mixed them again and could not help thinking: yes, this is it!

They are quite a bit dearer than the old drinks, though.

But everyone at the tavern has loved them.

Maybe I have found my way into the upper-level market~

Hehe, I am feeling a little proud. (๑•́ ₃ •̀๑)

The supplier sent a huge sign, too. They said it would stand out by the entrance.

I held it up to try it, and it covered the rain on the window perfectly.

...In the end, I put it away in the cupboard.

name: story_note_06_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_06_body
Xiaoman:
Yesterday I mentioned sending a traveller your way. Back at the tavern, I suddenly remembered the first time I walked into your shop.

I still did not know my way around. I only came in because the lights were on.

It was a pawnshop, but there was a cassette deck on the counter.

Even then, your shop felt a little mysterious.

I wonder if that traveller ever found it.

If he really came by, I hope he found something interesting too.

May your business keep getting better, senpai~

Here is this week's tape.

name: story_note_06_signature

name: xm_07_01
Xiaoman: Good evening, senpai. There is someone from the docks who comes to sit at the tavern almost every day.

name: xm_07_02

name: xm_07_shop
Xiaoman: I would like some food today. I brought {0} credits.

name: story_note_07_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_07_body
Xiaoman:
A group photo arrived from my friends back home today.

They left a space for me and even drew me into it. It looks nothing like me!

They asked me to send a photo from the station, too.

I looked through my album. Almost every recent photo was of bottles, glasses, or the rain on the window.

In the end, I just sent them one of the bar.

They replied, "The tavern alone does not count! We want you in the next one!"

Honestly, I only wanted to show them my little tavern.

Here is this week's tape.

name: story_note_07_signature

Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_08_01
Xiaoman: Good evening, senpai. My friends back home kept asking me to send a photo of myself.

name: xm_08_02

name: xm_08_shop

name: story_note_08_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_08_body
Xiaoman:
A girl left a glittering hair clip on the counter last night.

I was about to put it away for her when she hurried back.

But she did not ask about the clip. "Will you have that drink with the cherry tomorrow?"

I said yes and handed it back.

She laughed. "Keep it as a deposit for my next glass."

...Hey, this is a tavern!

For a moment, though, I actually wondered how many credits it was worth.

Senpai, this is all your fault. ( ˘•ω•˘ )

Of course I gave it back in the end.

Here is this week's tape.

Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_09_body
Xiaoman:
I have had my eye on a new ice maker lately.

It holds twice as much as mine and is much quieter. The seller says it is perfect for a little tavern.

I have even worked out where to put it.

The price is quite something, though.

Yesterday, while doing the accounts, I kept looking at its picture.

In the end, I decided to wait a little longer.

I have only just opened. There are still so many things to spend money on.

Saving up is such a pain~

Do you ever feel that way too, senpai?

name: xm_10_02

name: xm_10_shop

name: story_note_10_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_10_body
Xiaoman:
Remember the ice maker I mentioned last week?

The seller messaged me again today.

Apparently, if I pay the deposit now, delivery and installation are free.

I even opened the payment screen.

But after thinking about it for ages, I closed it again.

My current machine is a bit noisy, but the ice it makes is still quite good.

I will let it carry on working for now.

When will I ever be able to stop worrying about credits?

name: xm_11_01

name: xm_11_02

name: xm_11_shop
Xiaoman: I would like some everyday supplies today. I brought {0} credits.

name: story_note_11_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_11_body
Xiaoman:
Lately, after closing, I often sit behind the bar with the menu and supply invoices spread out together.

The drinks are the same, and I know they taste good.

But I can stare at the books for ages and still not see what went wrong.

I used to think good drinks and caring for every customer would slowly make the shop better.

Running a shop is much harder than I imagined.

When you first opened the pawnshop, did you have days when you did not know what to do?

I remember eagerly inviting you over when I opened.

Then, I just wanted you to see the tavern I had worked so hard to put together.

Now, there is so much I really want to learn from you.

I hope one day I can run my own little shop properly, like you.

... It feels embarrassing to say this in person, so I will write it instead.

name: story_note_12_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_12_body
Xiaoman:
Lately I have been closing earlier, so I often go for a walk along the shopping street.

When I first moved here, all the corridors looked the same. I could barely find my way back to where I lived.

Now I know when every sign goes dark, and which vending machines stay lit.

I have been here quite a while without even noticing, haven't I?

I remember telling you I was still getting lost the first time I came into your shop.

Now I could find my way with my eyes closed.

name: story_note_13_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_13_body
Xiaoman:
I booked my ticket home today.

While I was packing, the man from the repair shop next door came to help move a cabinet. He asked if I still needed that blue lamp.
I said he could have it. He said his daughter really liked the color.
Then it turned out he meant the whole frame attached to the sign, not just the lamp.
...He certainly knows what to pick.
Still, at least I won't have to find a box that big.

name: story_note_14_title
Xiaoman: Dear senpai,

name: story_note_14_body
Xiaoman:
When I checked the shelves for the last time, there were still enough ingredients for three drinks.

I picked my three favorites, sealed them up, and left them with the tape.

Mom says the cherry blossoms back home are almost gone.

I probably won't get there in time, but that is all right.

There will still be plenty of rainy days.

Before coming to this station, I never thought I would meet another person who listened to tapes in a pawnshop.

Senpai, thank you for all this time.

name: story_note_03_b_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper senpai,

name: story_note_03_b_body
Xiaoman:
Thank you for all your work yesterday!

I'd thought having another pair of hands would give us a little breathing room.

Then the customers kept coming, one after another. We barely had time for a proper conversation.

But after closing, I turned around and found the whole counter neatly tidied up.

Usually, I'd still have so much to do on my own.

Hehe. I was tired, but it was rather lovely.

Here's this week's tape.

name: story_note_04_b_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_04_b_body
Xiaoman:
After closing last night, I wrote our two shops' supply arrangement into my ledger.

Now we are officially business partners.

There is still so much you can teach me about running a shop.

And if anything comes up at your shop, come to me too! I will help however I can.

Not long ago I only bought a little water from you and carried it home in one small bag.

If it turns into crates and crates one day, will your counter have room for them all...?

Before that, though, I need to work out the orders properly. We both have a good business to run.

name: xm_08_accept

name: xm_08_bye

name: xm_tavern_07_chat_01
Xiaoman: Some people sit down and quietly listen to the rain. It is not really raining outside, but they seem to like it.

name: xm_tavern_07_chat_02
Xiaoman: Some people stop by for a drink before closing now. We never arrange it, but around that time I can almost tell who will walk through the door.

name: xm_tavern_08_chat_01
Xiaoman: The girls who took my photos spent ages choosing one with me. They came for a drink, but it was like I had hired photographers.

name: xm_tavern_08_chat_02
Xiaoman: They said they would bring some new colleagues next shift. If they really come, I will have to remember to get a few more ingredients ready.

name: xm_09_03

name: xm_09_accept
Xiaoman: Thank you. Just what I needed.

name: xm_09_bye
Xiaoman: I should go. Come sit for a while tonight if you have time.

name: xm_09_02_late
Xiaoman: I made an extra batch a little while ago, but it still was not enough.

name: xm_tavern_09_chat_01
Xiaoman: Senpai, lately I have been getting the ingredients for the popular drinks ready in advance.

name: xm_tavern_09_chat_02
Xiaoman: I used to get so flustered when people came in at once. I can finally take it a little more calmly now.

name: xm_tavern_09_chat_03
Xiaoman: At this rate, though, I might need another cabinet behind the bar.

name: xm_w09_news_title
Xiaoman: A new landmark: Polar Day Lounge opens

name: xm_w09_news_body
Xiaoman:
Polar Day, the new lounge from Tenquin Asset Corporation, opens today on the lower-level shopping street.

The venue features selected upper-level spirits, advanced bartending equipment and several opening-exclusive packages.

During the opening promotion, all items are available at 30% of their usual price. The shopping-street guide terminals now feature the new venue.

New customers can enjoy drinks worth 500 credits free of charge.

Tenquin says it will continue upgrading the lower-level shopping street to offer residents and interstellar travellers a better experience.

name: xm_10_03
Xiaoman: Ingredients that good, and everything at thirty percent of the usual price... Surely they cannot keep that up for long.

name: xm_10_04
Xiaoman: I ran into a few people who used to come to my tavern. They seemed quite happy to see me and said hello.

name: xm_10_05
Xiaoman: Bookings seem a little quieter lately. I want to watch for a few more days and wait for their promotion to end.

name: xm_10_accept
Xiaoman: Thank you. Just what I needed.

name: xm_10_bye
Xiaoman: I should go. You are always welcome to come sit for a while tonight, senpai, if you have time.

name: xm_10_01_late
Xiaoman: Good evening, senpai. Have you heard of Polar Day, the lounge that opened a little while ago? I went to have a look the other day.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_01
Xiaoman: Senpai, I have not been running short of ingredients for the new drinks lately.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_02
Xiaoman: Last week I was worried about running out, so I prepared extra. These past few days, more has been left over than I expected.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_03
Xiaoman: Luckily, some things keep for a long time. Otherwise it would be a bit of a waste.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_supported_01
Xiaoman: Senpai, lately I have been working out how much to order for the next batch again.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_supported_02
Xiaoman: At least the business in hand is carrying on as usual. What I prepared is being used up little by little too.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_supported_03
Xiaoman: I want to keep this pace for now and watch for a few more days.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_neutral_01
Xiaoman: Senpai, I want to think the next order through a little more carefully.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_neutral_02
Xiaoman: Some ingredients keep well; others need to be used while they are fresh. I will get things ready a little at a time, as needed.

name: xm_tavern_10_chat_neutral_03
Xiaoman: I will leave the menu as it is for now. I want to see how things go.

name: xm_tavern_10_regular_01
Xiaoman: Senpai, someone who had been here before came back today, and brought a friend.

name: xm_tavern_10_regular_02
Xiaoman: She said she could have taken the lift straight back to her dorm, but wanted to make a detour for a drink.

name: xm_tavern_10_regular_03
Xiaoman: One wanted something sweet, the other something sour. Then once I served them, they started swapping drinks.

name: xm_tavern_10_regular_04
Xiaoman: Hehe. It really did make me happy.

name: ui_w04_phone_agree
Xiaoman: Agree

name: ui_w04_phone_later

name: xm_11_03
Xiaoman: Fewer people have been coming lately, so I changed the opening hours. It used to say two in the morning; now it says midnight.

name: xm_11_04
Xiaoman: When I opened, I used to think everyone stayed too late. At least I can close up earlier now.

name: xm_11_accept
Xiaoman: Thank you. Just what I needed.

name: xm_11_bye
Xiaoman: I should head back. If you come by tonight, senpai, remember to come early.

name: xm_tavern_11_chat_01
Xiaoman: Senpai, I asked Merchant Development today when the tavern would get its turn on the guide terminals.

name: xm_tavern_11_chat_02
Xiaoman: They said the promotional slots had to follow the shopping street's latest arrangements, and asked me to wait a little longer.

name: xm_tavern_11_chat_03
Xiaoman: But when I applied for the support, they said they would help new shops bring people in...

name: xm_w11_news_title
Xiaoman: Polar Day Lounge extends its opening promotion

name: xm_w11_news_body
Xiaoman:
Tenquin Asset Corporation announced today that the opening promotion at its Polar Day Lounge will be extended again.

All items remain available at 30% of their usual price, and new customers can still enjoy free drinks worth 500 credits.

The company says residents and interstellar travellers have warmly welcomed the offers. An end date will be announced separately.

Shopping-street guide terminals will continue giving priority to Polar Day Lounge and its promotional information.

name: xm_12_03

name: xm_12_04

name: xm_12_accept

name: xm_13_03

name: xm_13_05

name: xm_13_accept

name: xm_13_bye

name: xm_tavern_12_roka_01

name: xm_tavern_12_roka_02

name: xm_tavern_12_roka_03

name: xm_tavern_12_roka_04

name: xm_tavern_12_business_01

name: xm_tavern_12_business_03

name: xm_tavern_12_business_04

name: xm_tavern_12_business_05
